skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain basic knowledge about society and sociology, history of formation and development of sociological ideas.
Master research methods in sociology, techniques for collecting and processing social information.
Analyze social structure and its components related to society building such as class, ethnicity, population, gender, territory, profession.
Understand the nature of group linkage and its influence on individual life.
Explain the manifestations and significance of social inequality and stratification research.
Understand the concept, nature, function of social institutions and their role in social life.
Understand the concepts, components, and expressions of culture in daily social life.
Understand the process of socialization and its impact on individuals and society.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze social phenomena and processes.
Develop self-management skills to adapt to social changes and modernize through practical activities.
